data.name: Cenote Project [Open-Air Sunset Party] with Cristian Arango and Friends
data.description:
Cenote Project, “Sun Down Moon Rise,” is a seasonal open-air rooftop odyssey, from Memorial Day Weekend to Labor Day Weekend. Floating high above the pulse of the city, it becomes a skybound sanctuary—reborn with each gathering through the collective breath of our community.

We come together in sacred celebration—hearts open, spirits stirred—drawn by the rhythm of sound, the language of art, and the alchemy of atmosphere. As the sun softens into dusk, beginning every Sunday at 5 PM, world-renowned artists take us on transcendent journeys through music—sonic ceremonies that awaken, elevate, and transform.

Presented by Somewhere Nowhere.

This is a 21+ event
